instruction: Repair {{entry}}, a POSIX sh script taking directory and keep-count arguments. Only regular non-symlink files named snap-<unsigned decimal timestamp>.dat directly inside the directory are snapshots. Keep the numerically newest keep-count snapshots and delete older ones; ties are broken by LC_ALL=C filename order, retaining earlier names first. Zero keeps none. Ignore unrelated names, directories and symlinks. Validate arguments before deleting anything. Filenames contain no tabs/newlines; timestamps fit nine decimal digits. Success prints nothing.
